reviewed_claim: For three distinct plane centres, the full strict unit-distance graph on the centres and their complete unit circles is four-colourable whenever some centre-pair distance is at least three; the bound is sharp at equality.
global_corollary: Every dominating triple in a non-four-colourable plane unit-distance graph has diameter strictly less than three.
minor_clarification: In Section 3 of the source proof, if the centrally assigned intersection set Ms is empty, its leaf centre may receive either central-palette colour; there is no common colour to oppose.
open_boundary: all three centre-pair distances strictly below three, and after the unit-edge theorem all three differ from one
